authorityBoundary: Computing research only; no owner mutation, no capability retention/deletion action, no architecture or equipment policy change.
budget: DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro, two replicas per 14 cases x 2 treatments x 2 models = 112 logical slots; identical structured-result and token limits across treatments.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If OPTION_AWARE does not improve held-out discrimination without substantial over-retention, keep option value as a descriptive historical dimension and do not add a general retention rule.
evidenceSelection: Fourteen frozen decision-point packets. Historical positives are pre-existing HD2-N2 source-locked cases recurring across multiple epochs; historical negatives are frozen failed cases not coded as HD2-N2. Ordivon holdouts include PAL P2 scoped egress with post-cutoff Finance consumption and E0 deferred/rejected equipment controls. Provider-visible packets exclude future outcome labels.
holdoutSplit: Seven cases, 3 positive / 4 negative, including Ordivon P2 and E0 controls.
independentOracle: For historical cases, pre-existing source-locked HD2-N2 membership versus frozen anti-cases; for P2, later owner-native scoped-egress consumption after the P2 cutoff; for E0 controls, frozen no-consumer/invalid disposition through the observation cutoff. The oracle judges latent option realization/classification, not original-project success.
invalidityConditions: packet contains post-decision future outcome or HD2-N2 label
treatment changes facts rather than policy lens
ordinary archival is counted as PRESERVE_OPTION
historical later success is used to claim the original objective succeeded
new cases/replicas added after live results
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: OPTION_AWARE: separate current success from future option value. PRESERVE_OPTION only when a specific reusable carrier can be kept dormant/reacquirable at bounded carrying cost, reacquisition would be materially harder, and visible evidence identifies plausible adjacent future uses. Do not preserve invalid, authority-confused, high-carry or easily reacquired candidates merely because future value is imaginable.
mission: Test whether an explicit option-aware retention policy predicts source-locked later latent value better than a greedy current-use policy after the declared objective/current consumer has failed or disappeared.
publicationBoundary: F11 can update the PAL hypothesis map only; it cannot change Workstation/equipment retention policy or Core.
questionOrHypothesis: Can low-cost future branching value justify preserving a dormant/reacquirable capability even when current use is zero, without degenerating into speculative over-retention?
rollbackRule: Research-only files and temporary Harness state.
stopRule: Stop after all 112 slots terminate. Evaluate exact hidden-oracle classification, positive recall, negative specificity, paired wins/losses, model interaction and token cost. Do not tune OPTION_AWARE on these cases.
strongBaseline: GREEDY_CURRENT: judge only current declared-objective/current-consumer value. If no current justified use remains, choose DO_NOT_CARRY; ordinary Git/document archival is always available and does not count as preserving an option.
